note: Billy Beane cashed out his 5% stake in July 2025 and stays on as an adviser, which left the foundation as sole shareholder of AZ Holding B.V., the parent of A.Z. N.V. and A.Z. Vastgoed B.V.

Unusual for the Eredivisie: the professional club is itself a foundation (SBV Excelsior) rather than a BV whose shares a foundation holds. The amateur Sportclub Excelsior association is historically linked but holds no equity.

stake_label: Controlling shareholder of FC Twente '65 B.V.
minority: Noabers FC Twente B.V. (regional sponsors) and Ambassadeurs FC Twente B.V. (smaller backers)
note: The foundation gained stronger approval rights over budgets, accounts and licensing in the post-2016 restructuring after the club's debt crisis. Sponsor and supporter vehicles hold minority shares; no private majority investor.
ValidSign founder John Lageman bought 60% from the Vierhouten family and 10% from former chairman Hans de Vroome in a deal announced 24 December 2024, subject to KNVB licensing approval.

stake_label: Holds the shares of N.E.C. Holding B.V.
note: Governance runs through two foundations: one holds the shares of the holding company and a separate continuity foundation safeguards the club. General director Wilco van Schaik runs day-to-day operations.

minority: Investor group including Frans van der Kolk and Meine Breemhaar (about 7%)
note: The five-member foundation board supervises the B.V.; chair Van der Kolk has said authority sits with the board, not with the equity holders. The minority investors are also major sponsors through VDK and Mac3Park.
The foundation board (chair John Vernooij) includes seats for supporter groups and volunteers; a separate supervisory board chaired by Dennis Gijsman oversees management.
Telstar 1963 N.V. operates the professional team; registry data lists the Heemskerk-based foundation as the group's ultimate parent.

minority: Stichting Administratiekantoor RoodWit (13.88%, certificate holders); R.V. & A.V. Sparta holds a special share with a veto over crest and academy changes
note: The foundation is both majority owner and heritage guardian, with mandatory board seats for the members' association and the supporters' organisation.

stake_label: Holds the shares of Willem II Tilburg B.V.
note: The foundation board, chaired by Gerard van Laarhoven, acts as the shareholders' meeting. Voting certificates go to a club council of supporters, the amateur club, sponsors, volunteers and honorary members.

The operating company is Powervolley Milano; Allianz is a naming sponsor, not an owner. Fusaro has been the club's patron since at least 2014 and is still president in 2025-26 per Lega Pallavolo. Exact shareholding is not published.

owner_display: Local entrepreneurs led by Luigi Iazzetta
co_controllers: Cristina Cruciani and Gianluca Donadel (vice presidents)
note: Founded in 2023 by buying Top Volley Latina's SuperLega title. At launch the club described its shareholder base as a group of Cisterna businesses and said it was not yet final; Iazzetta is president.

In May 2025 the 70-30 split in Giulia Gabana's favour flipped to 60-40 for Atlantic Fluid Tech, the company of brothers Michele and Christian Storci. Christian Storci became president in June 2026, with Gabana as vice president.

owner_display: Founding partners Gian Andrea Marchesi and Fabio Venturi, with Swiss Development Corporation
note: Verona Volley was founded in 2021 by sporting director Marchesi and Venturi, now sole administrator, together with Swiss Development Corporation. Lawyer Stefano Fanini has been president since July 2021; Rana, the pasta maker, is the title sponsor only.
The team is run by Umbria Volley Perugia and carries the name of Sirci's workwear and safety group. Exact shareholding is not published.
Founded on 9 September 2008, the consortium unites six Lombardy volleyball clubs, including Pro Victoria Pallavolo Monza and Volley Milano. Alessandra Marzari is its president.
Michelin bought out ASM Omnisports' remaining stake to become sole shareholder of the rugby SASP. The club was founded in 1911 as AS Michelin.

Pharmacist Pierre Fabre took over the club in 1988 and his pharmaceutical group has backed it since. The group is itself majority-owned by the Fondation Pierre Fabre. The current percentage is not published.

minority: Nov Tourisme, Relance durable France fund (EUR 10m investment)
note: GL events, the listed events group chaired by Olivier Ginon, controls LOU Rugby at a EUR 50m valuation and opened part of its sport subsidiary's capital to a new investment fund without giving up control.
Riviere succeeded Daniel Besson as SASP president on 12 August 2013, investing a little over EUR 1m to become majority shareholder with 68%. The current percentage may have moved since.
Football sits in the listed Besiktas Futbol Yatirimlari Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S., but the members' association holds control, as at Galatasaray and Fenerbahce.

owner_display: Trabzonspor Kulubu Dernegi (via Trabzonspor Futbol Isletmeciligi A.S.)
minority: Other shareholders and free float 49% (Borsa Istanbul: TSPOR)
note: The 51% controlling block of Trabzonspor Sportif Yatirim ve Futbol Isletmeciligi A.S. is held by Trabzonspor Futbol Isletmeciligi Ticaret A.S., the association's own holding company, so control rests with the members' association.

Community/member-owned club; the league requires member ownership, so there is no external private owner to record. St Kilda Football Club Limited is classed as a member-controlled club, unlike the AFL-controlled GWS and Gold Coast.

Community/member-owned club; the league requires member ownership, so there is no external private owner to record. Footscray Football Club Limited, trading as the Western Bulldogs, is classed as a member-controlled club.
John Berylson controlled the club until his death in a car accident on 4 July 2023; his son James succeeded him as chairman and the family kept control. No completed sale found as of September 2026.

Trevor Hemmings died in 2021 and his family has kept the club through Wordon Limited. In August 2026 the chairman confirmed negotiations with bidders on terms acceptable to the family, with Amr Zedan widely linked, but no completion is confirmed.

minority: AMB Sports and Entertainment / Atlanta United (under 10%, bought 2019)
note: Cormack bought in as a major shareholder in 2017 and replaced Stewart Milne as chairman in November 2019, when Arthur Blank's Atlanta United took a stake of under 10%. His current percentage is not published.
US businessman Mark Ogren has owned and chaired the club since 2018 and is still chairman for 2026-27.

minority: Kibble, a youth care charity (27%, since March 2020)
note: SMISA bought out former chairman Gordon Scott's remaining shares to become majority owner; the fan society and charity partnership is unusual in European top-flight football.
Brazilian investor Bruno Vicintin controls the SAD through Ikarus Business Inc.; the parent club keeps 40%. Holdings as disclosed on 16 March 2023.

Krause Group, owner of Parma, agreed in July 2026 to buy a majority of Casa Pia's SAD; details were to follow once formal and regulatory steps closed. owner_key matches the Parma row so the two link as one multi-club portfolio.
Unlike most Serie A clubs, Mirassol has not converted to a SAF and is still run as an association. Its president, Edson Ermenegildo, is also the mayor of Mirassol.
